**Wang Fu – Asian Restaurant in Zirl**

Discover authentic Asian flavors in the heart of **Zirl**! At **Wang Fu**, we bring you a culinary journey through the vibrant tastes of Asia, from fragrant Thai curries to delicate sushi rolls and hearty noodle dishes. Our cozy yet stylish setting offers the perfect atmosphere to enjoy your meal with friends or family.

Try our signature dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** with an Asian twist or savor traditional specialties such as **Mala Xiang Gu** (spicy Sichuan fish) and **Pad Thai**. Whether you're craving something spicy, fresh, or comforting, **Wang Fu** has something for every palate.

Located just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and nestled in the beautiful **Tirol** countryside, **Wang Fu** is your gateway to a taste of Asia without leaving the Alps. Come experience the fusion of Eastern and Western flavors in this charming mountain village!
